caption.ja: 人口保存と2モードの初期線形化を別々に検査します。 保存値だけを描画します。 時間・濃度・個体数の軸は空間次元ではありません。率は教育用で疾病・実験予測ではありません。
caption.en: Check population conservation and the full two-mode initial linearization separately. This figure reads saved data only. Time, concentrations and populations do not define a spatial dimension. The rates are educational, not disease or experimental predictions.

formula: \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-\beta SI,&\dot E&=\beta SI-\sigma E,\\\dot I&=\sigma E-\gamma I,&\dot R&=\gamma I.\end{aligned}

note.ja: 出生死亡なし・全人口一定の教育用率です。初期過渡は2×2行列指数に比較し、感染症予測には使いません。
note.en: Educational rates with no births or deaths and constant population. Compare the early transient with a full two-by-two matrix exponential; no disease forecast is made.

equation_note.en: Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20. There are no births, deaths or external inflows.

note.ja: 人口保存と2モードの初期線形化を別々に検査します。
note.en: Check population conservation and the full two-mode initial linearization separately.

references.formula: \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-\beta SI,&\dot E&=\beta SI-\sigma E,\\\dot I&=\sigma E-\gamma I,&\dot R&=\gamma I.\end{aligned};\quad \beta=0.6,\quad\sigma=0.3,\quad\gamma=0.2,\quad(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1-2\eta,\eta,\eta,0);\quad S+E+I+R=1,\quad\eta\in\{10^{-4},5\times10^{-5}\};\quad \begin{pmatrix}E_{\rm lin}(t)\\ I_{\rm lin}(t)\end{pmatrix}=\exp\!\left[t\begin{pmatrix}-0.3&0.6\\0.3&-0.2\end{pmatrix}\right]\begin{pmatrix}\eta\\\eta\end{pmatrix}

assumptions.en: Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20. There are no births, deaths or external inflows.

note.ja: 2つの小初期感染量による固定係数の整合性比較です。早期線形化をt=20全体の厳密解と見なさず、単一の優勢モードで両モードを置き換えません。実流行の予測・統計的被覆・任意人口への一般保証は行いません。
note.en: These fixed-coefficient calculations compare two small initial infection levels. The early linearization is not an exact solution through t=20, and a single dominant mode does not replace the two-mode solution. No epidemic forecast, statistical coverage or arbitrary-population guarantee is claimed.

reference_note.ja: t≤20の全ODE積分誤差・人口保存・非負性と、0≤t≤1の201参照点での線形化モデル誤差を分けます。参照では両ηの尺度付きJacobian、Radau/BDF差とη²に対する余裕、解析的な全行列指数を別資格しています。
reference_note.en: Separate full-ODE integration error, population conservation and nonnegativity through t=20 from linearization-model error at 201 reference points on 0≤t≤1. Qualify scaled Jacobians, Radau/BDF agreement with an η² margin and the analytic full matrix exponential independently.

method_note.ja: 全4状態を固定400/800/1600ステップのRK4で積分。独立非線形参照は偏差をηで尺度化してRadau/BDFで求め、早期のE・I線形化は2×2行列指数の両モードを使います。
method_note.en: Evolve all four physical states with RK4 at 400, 800 and 1600 fixed steps. Independently compute the nonlinear reference with scaled-deviation Radau/BDF and the early E/I linearization with both modes of the full 2×2 matrix exponential.
